purpose: Derive actual treatment numeric code from TRT01A
call: %adsl_trtvar(inds=adsl, srcvar=TRT01A, trtvar=TRT01A, trtnvar=TRT01AN, map=Placebo=0|Drug A 50mg=1|Drug A 100mg=2);

purpose: Derive ITT population flag from ARM

purpose: Derive enrolled population flag from RFICDTC
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=ENRLFL, cond=not missing(RFICDTC), label=Enrolled Population Flag);

purpose: Derive randomised population flag from RANDDT
call: %adsl_popflag(inds=adsl, flagvar=RANDFL, cond=not missing(RANDDT), label=Randomised Population Flag);

purpose: Derive entered treatment epoch flag from TRTEPSDT
